title: Jeralt And Byleth Travel
prompt:
Jeralt and Byleth walk along the stone mountain road behind Church knight escorts. Jeralt glances toward the monastery with guarded suspicion; Byleth remains quiet and unreadable. Cloaks and banners move lightly in the wind.

Camera: medium-wide tracking move from the side and slightly behind.
